featured_reviews.name: Priyanshu Deshraju
featured_reviews.review_text:
Updated: This review is subjective, because I had joined the classes (1 month verbal crash course) around 11th November, about 1.5 months before my actual GMAT. and I had also taken only one test offered in the class. (out of 5-6)  Additionally, I had not attended the Quant classes , but had access to few online questions. The questions for Quant looked good, but please use your judgment and maybe do a trial beforehand.
This was the first result from a simple google search for GMAT classes in Mumbai. But overall the classes didn't help me much. There were many important topics which I think weren't covered in the class. Topics such as idioms for sentence correction were not discussed,  practice on "sentence meaning" in sentence correction, techniques in RC were not taught, and for CR techniques like the negation technique in Assumptions and the yes/no technique for evaluation were taught, but reasoning , cause-effect, and practice on hard questions was not sufficient. Practice was provided for major CR type questions though.Resources given were several homework sheets and to do in class sheets,  verbal question bank ( 200 questions, but more like grammar practice), and online tests. The online verbal practice material was easier compared to the actual GMAT and the GMAT prep software. The exercises for basic grammar were okay, but they are not enough for a hard sentence correction question.

Overall, it gave me a start for my studies, but covering major topics and finding tough questions was something I had to do on my own, I realized that after giving GMAT. I had joined the classes presuming that I can give gmat in 1.5 month after completing a 1 month crash course(20hrs) using this class; however, now I have realized that if the amount I had spent for these classes (~20k Rs), had been spent to do self study using books and online tests ( Powerscore CR bible, Manhattan SC guide, Aristotle SC grail, Manhattan RC guide) with a little more time given to self study, then my GMAT results could have been better. I relied too much on these classes which could also be a mistake. This review could be true for all verbal crash course gmat experiences. Hence, I suggest please use your own judgemnet. Thanks for reading, and best of luck for your exams.

featured_reviews.name: Vidhaan Bohra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience with Imperial Overseas Education, and I cannot recommend them enough!
I am thrilled to share that I will be attending the University of Melbourne for the July 2026 intake, and this journey would not have been as smooth without the incredible support of the team at Imperial Overseas.
Right from the start,my IELTS examination, my entire university application process was handled with great professionalism and care. Saloni ma'am and Urmila ma'am were absolutely fantastic throughout — they guided me step by step, ensured all my documents were in order, and made the whole application process feel effortless. They were always approachable, patient, and genuinely invested in helping me achieve my dream of studying abroad. I never felt lost or confused at any point, which truly speaks to their dedication and expertise.
When it came to the visa process, Saloni ma'am was a gem! The entire experience was completely smooth with zero issues. She made sure I understood every requirement, kept me updated at every stage, and ensured there were no last-minute surprises. What could have been a stressful process felt totally stress-free thanks to her guidance.
Whenever I had queries — big or small — they were resolved promptly and clearly. I never had to wait long for answers, and the team always made me feel like a priority.

featured_reviews.name: Dhruv Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Imperial helped alot especially for the Visa formalities and mock interviews. Their counsellors were always available to solve any query. Hiren sir was very helpful throughout the process from shortlisting universities to conducting mock interviews himself. Priyanka ma'am also helped a lot for form filling, documents, and general queries. Overall a great experience for me!

featured_reviews.name: devarshi jadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
My entire coaching experience at Imperial was a thoroughly well rounded and guided one. A first and special mention to Manoj sir, who was so patient and kind with us, along with his incredible knowledge and teaching skills. He helped me a lot through my entire time, always there to support and motivate us when we were nervous or anxious, even sharing interesting stories and anecdotes with us. His valuable experience about these competitive exams and the challenges with it, is truly one of a kind and I am grateful to have been taught by him. His ability to find a creative approach to solving problems and help us understand concepts clearly is amazing. Secondly, to Taiyyaba and Sylvia ma’am, your approach to even the most difficult TOEFL and GRE questions made me believe that I could ace the exam with your support. The strategies you taught us to improve our understanding and approach to verbal questions was super useful, something I’ll always remember! The classes were always engaging and interactive, which also improved the entire learning experience.
A big thank you to the entire coaching team at Imperial, spearheaded by Manoj Sir, for their constant encouragement and commitment. I could not have done this without them and I have some of the most fond memories from this time! And of course, a whole lot of gratitude to Hiren Sir, who is one of the best people you can possibly meet as your advisor and mentor! His passion, dedication, and skills are unmatched! Trust him to always guide you well and make the correct decisions for your bright future! His advice, his guidance, and his commitment towards giving the best to students such ad myself is one of a kind! Always grateful!

featured_reviews.name: Aagam Gosalia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience with Imperial Overseas for my GRE and TOEFL preparation. When I first began, I was very confused about how to approach these exams. I didn’t know how to structure my preparation, or which areas required more focus. The entire process felt overwhelming.
The faculty at Imperial played a huge role in removing my fear of these exams. Their approachable and supportive nature made it easy to ask questions and clear even the smallest doubts without hesitation during classes.They provided clear guidance on concepts and effective strategies to approach each section, which built my confidence.
I’m truly grateful to the Imperial team for helping me streamline my preparation and believe in myself. I would highly recommend their coaching to anyone preparing for these exams.

featured_reviews.name: Sumeet Bhimanpally
featured_reviews.review_text: Imperial’s excellent, highly immersive resources and their timely, crucial guidance gave me a clear path to approach both the TOEFL and GRE, ultimately playing the biggest role in my score. Special thanks to Manoj Sir for helping students recognize their potential, I truly enjoyed the experience!

featured_reviews.name: Heet Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a really positive experience preparing for both GRE and IELTS with Imperial.

For GRE, the verbal and quant sessions by Dr. Manoj Saigal sir and Sylvia ma’am were extremely well taught. The concepts were broken down in a very clear and practical way, which made even the tougher topics feel manageable. What helped me the most was the large number of practice questions from the notes and the LMS portal they were very close to actual exam difficulty and really strengthened my problem-solving speed and accuracy.

For IELTS, Sylvia ma’am supported me across all four sections — Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking. She made sure I understood different question scenarios, revised strategies multiple times, and constantly pushed us through mock tests. Those repeated revisions and mocks made a big difference in my confidence on test day and helped me achieve an overall band score of 7.5.

Overall, I’m really glad I chose Imperial for my preparation. The structured guidance, practice material, and consistent feedback played a big role in my results.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Rudalph Gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text:
When I first thought about studying abroad, I was completely clueless – I didn’t know which countries to consider, what courses would suit me, or even which exams I needed to take. Imperial Overseas guided me through every single step, helping me figure out the best options based on my academics, skills, and interests.

The team was extremely supportive throughout the process – from drafting my SOPs to guiding me with my visa application and clarifying every small doubt I had along the way. What I really appreciate is how friendly and approachable every member of the team is, which made the entire journey smooth and stress-free.

I’m truly grateful to Imperial Overseas for making what seemed like a confusing process feel simple and achievable. I would wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone aspiring to study abroad.
